correctness.rationale: Every nonalgebraic type uniquely specifies a lower ideal L, an upper filter U with all l<u, and the random-poset extension property realizes each such one-point extension. Lower-set coordinate maxima (i,j) admit J(i−1,j−1) lower sets; the upper-right filter J(a−i+1,b−j+1) has precisely one forbidden option when the corner is included. Summing over all maxima and using marked monotone lattice-path inclusion–exclusion yields the exact two-binomial closed form. Equality types contribute ab; elementary binomial identities yield square asymptotic and fixed-a leading coefficient. Independent direct exhaustive enumeration for all 16 grids 1≤a,b≤4 agrees and computes square counts through 8.
